objective: Start PQ-07 scoped qualification by implementing a bounded, read-only candidate-dossier and evidence-gap assessor. Reconcile protected PR #38 source integration precisely; never promote candidate-provided evidence to independently authenticated production qualification.
nonGoals: No public release, signing, API credentials, project adoption, live target operation, publication, migration or deployment
No assertion that local HMAC/mock/SQLite/source tests provide authenticated publisher, CI checkout, immutable remote retention or real production evidence
No change to existing SF-19 synthetic fixture acceptance or weakening of protected CI controls
No merge to main before separate explicit next merge cadence and protected queue checks
decisions: Define claim and evidence bindings based on the frozen PQ-00 oracle; rejected, missing and present-unverified never equal accepted.
Require external independently checked publisher, CI, effect grant, artifact custody, real crash/target/operations evidence before any positive production disposition.
Preserve existing portable SF-19 synthetic verifier and historical candidate evidence, and update plan/README from exact protected PR #38 integration.

obligations.description: Reject unknown/duplicated fields and inconsistent identifiers in candidate dossier; bind each claim observation to the exact commit, tree, artifact and reference profile.
Distinguish omitted, mismatched and present-but-unauthenticated claims; no self-certified producer strings, fixture statuses or unsupported profiles can produce productionQualified true.
Record protected PR #38 exact main SHA and merge_group run, with retained limitations and SF-R10 unmet; do not imply production approval.

structure: src/sf/production_dossier.py: strict, bounded dossier structure and fail-closed status classifications
tests/test_production_dossier.py: missing, mismatched, malformed, self-claimed, unsupported and all-present unqualified cases
docs/factory/evidence/PQ-07A.md: exact source integration, missing external evidence and testing
docs/factory/SF_PRODUCTION_QUALIFICATION_PLAN.md and README.md: post-PR38 source status, not qualification
impact: Read-only offline assessor; no new external effect capability or dependency, existing CLI and fixture behavior unchanged
Immutable work-order-first and no mandatory human reviewer/CI policy changes

budget.network: GitHub repository writes for branch/PR only; no external provider query
budget.execution: One normal PR-stage CI run on stable candidate, no extra reruns; merge not authorized in this package

externalEffects: Create only PQ-07A branch and reviewable draft PR; no merge before user-defined next cadence
No production credentials, targets, adopter projects, releases or repository ruleset mutations
